title: RVDV Axe Overlay
description: Hello! This is my private axe overlay for 1.21.x
body:
Hello! 

Today I'll be showcasing my personal / private axe overlay for 1.21.x. It changes the diamond sword and axe texture to look a lot cleaner when playing survival or PVP. I love this pack and use it all of the time. 

Hope you enjoy it, until next time!
